title: Web App vs Mobile App: Which Should a UK Small Business Build?
meta_title: Web App vs Mobile App: Which Should You Build? (UK)
meta_description: Web apps cost less and work on every phone; native apps get the app stores and full phone features. Costs, pros and cons for UK small businesses.
keywords: web app or app for small business

faq.q: Is a web app cheaper than a mobile app?
faq.a: Usually yes, because one build works on every device and there are no store reviews or fees. Web apps start from around £1,249; native apps from £3,499 at fixed price or £8,000 or more at agencies.

faq.q: Can a web app send push notifications?
faq.a: Yes, on Android and on iPhone when the web app is added to the home screen. Native apps still offer more control.
Partly. They can cache some content, but native apps handle offline use much better.

faq.q: Will my web app appear in the App Store?
faq.a: No. Web apps are found through your website and Google. Choose a native app if store listings matter.

faq.q: Which is better for a small business?
faq.a: For most small businesses, a web app first. Move to native once customers are using it regularly and need native features.
